key.name: sigkill-key
key.description: The integer key symbol to hold to forcefully kill the window's process using SIGKILL. (Default: 65505 for Shift_L)

key.name: sigterm-key
key.description: The integer key symbol to hold to gracefully terminate the window's process using SIGTERM. (Default: 0 for None)

key.name: sigkill-color
key.description: The CSS color value used for the window close button when armed for SIGKILL.

key.name: sigterm-color
key.description: The CSS color value used for the window close button when armed for SIGTERM.

key.name: enable-notifications
key.description: Show a desktop notification when a process is killed.
